name: Connect Contact Form 7 and AWeber
author: Renzo Johnson

sections.description:
Connect Contact Form 7 to AWeber and automatically add form subscribers to your AWeber mailing lists using the AWeber API. Choose a list per form, map subscriber fields, and pick the opt-in workflow that fits your audience.

Each Contact Form 7 form can use its own AWeber list and settings, so one WordPress site can feed several lists: a newsletter signup, a lead-capture form, and a contact form can each go to the right place.

AWeber Integration for Contact Form 7

  • Choose an AWeber list per form: send different Contact Form 7 forms to different lists.
  • Map subscriber fields: map the email address, name, and supported AWeber custom fields.
  • Choose single or double opt-in: send subscribers directly, or require the AWeber confirmation email.
  • Add an optional consent checkbox: send data only when the visitor selects the checkbox.
  • Configure inside Contact Form 7: manage credentials, list selection, and field mappings in the form editor.

From the developers of the Contact Form 7 Mailchimp extension, and the Campaign Monitor, GetResponse, and iContact integrations. Browse all our free WordPress plugins.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.4 or higher
  • Contact Form 7 5.0 or higher
  • An active AWeber account

External Service: AWeber

Connects your forms to the AWeber API.

Support

For the fastest help, contact us directly and the developers will answer you. Setup guides are available in the plugin documentation.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin.
  2. Search for “Connect Contact Form 7 and AWeber”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Upload the integrate-contact-form-7-and-aweber folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.

Configuration

After activation, edit any Contact Form 7 form and open the AWeber tab to authorize your account, select a mailing list, and map your fields. For step-by-step instructions, see the documentation.
sections.faq:
How do I connect Contact Form 7 to AWeber?

Edit a Contact Form 7 form, open the AWeber tab, and authorize the plugin with your AWeber account. Then choose a mailing list, map the email and subscriber fields, and save. See the authorization guide for the step-by-step process.

Can Contact Form 7 add subscribers to different AWeber lists?

Yes. Each Contact Form 7 form stores its own AWeber list and field-mapping settings, so different forms can feed different lists.

Can I map custom Contact Form 7 fields to AWeber?

Yes. Map supported Contact Form 7 fields to AWeber custom fields to capture more than just email and name.

What is the difference between single and double opt-in?

Single opt-in adds subscribers directly to your list. Double opt-in sends an AWeber confirmation email that the subscriber must click before being added. Double opt-in is recommended for better list quality and consent.

How do I add an opt-in checkbox to my form?

Add an optional checkbox so visitors choose whether to subscribe. See the opt-in checkbox guide for instructions.

The plugin isn’t working. How do I troubleshoot?

First, confirm your AWeber authorization is active and that your form’s email field is mapped. If issues persist, contact us and the developers will help you.
